methodology.candidate_rule: Record every distinct regex-relevant semantic capability, behavior, modifier, operation-sensitive behavior, interaction, result/replacement facet, diagnostic/resource behavior, or historical capability encountered.
methodology.census_question: What user-observable regex capability exists here that is not yet represented canonically?
methodology.claim: exhaustive to the strongest defensible declared cutoff; not a claim of timeless omniscience
methodology.exhaustion_rule: Freeze only after governed facility-family reconciliation and independent omission passes yield existing identities, manifestations, variants/interactions, non-regex items, or explicit unresolved candidates.
methodology.identity_rule: Split materially different observable behavior; merge spelling-only differences; model recurring composition as typed interaction unless it has independent semantics.

modifiers.name: case-insensitive
modifiers.semantic_effect: Select case-insensitive matching.

modifiers.name: multiline-anchors
modifiers.semantic_effect: Make line boundaries participate in anchor semantics.

modifiers.name: dotall
modifiers.semantic_effect: Allow the wildcard atom to match governed newline sequences.

modifiers.name: extended-spacing
modifiers.semantic_effect: Ignore pattern spacing and recognize pattern comments.

modifiers.name: explicit-capture
modifiers.semantic_effect: Disable implicit unnamed capture allocation.

modifiers.name: ungreedy-default
modifiers.semantic_effect: Invert the default greediness of ordinary quantifiers.

modifiers.name: unicode-mode
modifiers.semantic_effect: Select a Unicode code-point or scalar matching domain.

modifiers.name: unicode-properties
modifiers.semantic_effect: Enable Unicode property semantics for shorthand classes.

modifiers.name: ascii-restriction
modifiers.semantic_effect: Restrict otherwise Unicode-aware classes or boundaries to ASCII.

modifiers.name: locale-sensitive
modifiers.semantic_effect: Select locale or collation-dependent character behavior.

modifiers.name: literal-pattern
modifiers.semantic_effect: Treat pattern text as literal data.

modifiers.name: right-to-left
modifiers.semantic_effect: Search from higher positions toward lower positions.

modifiers.name: nonbacktracking-engine
modifiers.semantic_effect: Select a nonbacktracking matcher with a restricted feature set.

modifiers.name: posix-longest
modifiers.semantic_effect: Select leftmost-longest match disambiguation.

modifiers.name: sticky
modifiers.semantic_effect: Require the next match to begin at the mutable cursor.

modifiers.name: global
modifiers.semantic_effect: Enable repeated host-managed matching or replacement.

modifiers.name: has-indices
modifiers.semantic_effect: Request capture span arrays in the host's native index unit.

modifiers.name: newline-convention
modifiers.semantic_effect: Select which sequences are line breaks.

modifiers.name: backslash-r-convention
modifiers.semantic_effect: Select which sequences the generic newline atom consumes.

modifiers.name: dollar-end-only
modifiers.semantic_effect: Remove the before-final-newline meaning of the dollar anchor.

modifiers.name: first-line
modifiers.semantic_effect: Forbid match starts after the first line.

modifiers.name: allow-duplicate-names
modifiers.semantic_effect: Permit multiple captures with one name.

modifiers.name: no-auto-possess
modifiers.semantic_effect: Disable automatic possessification.

modifiers.name: not-empty
modifiers.semantic_effect: Reject an otherwise successful empty match.

modifiers.name: not-beginning-of-line
modifiers.semantic_effect: Tell the matcher that the subject start is not a line start.

modifiers.name: not-end-of-line
modifiers.semantic_effect: Tell the matcher that the subject end is not a line end.

modifiers.name: partial-soft
modifiers.semantic_effect: Prefer a complete match over a partial match.

modifiers.name: partial-hard
modifiers.semantic_effect: Prefer a viable partial match even when a complete match exists.

modifiers.name: fuzzy-best
modifiers.semantic_effect: Prefer the lowest-cost approximate match.

modifiers.name: fuzzy-enhance
modifiers.semantic_effect: Improve the fit of the next approximate match.

modifiers.name: single-match-per-pattern
modifiers.semantic_effect: Report at most one match for each member of a pattern set.

modifiers.name: prefilter
modifiers.semantic_effect: Permit a superset of true matches for later confirmation.

operations.name: compile
operations.semantic_contract: Compile or validate a pattern without requiring a successful match.

operations.name: test
operations.semantic_contract: Return whether a pattern has a match.

operations.name: prefix-match
operations.semantic_contract: Attempt a match at a required starting position.

operations.name: full-match
operations.semantic_contract: Require the match to consume the complete governed subject region.

operations.name: search
operations.semantic_contract: Find the first applicable match in a governed subject region.

operations.name: next-match
operations.semantic_contract: Advance an explicit matcher cursor to the next match.

operations.name: find-all
operations.semantic_contract: Enumerate non-overlapping matches under the host advancement rule.

operations.name: find-overlapping
operations.semantic_contract: Enumerate matches whose spans may overlap.

operations.name: extract
operations.semantic_contract: Return a whole-match or selected-capture value.

operations.name: count
operations.semantic_contract: Count governed match occurrences.

operations.name: position
operations.semantic_contract: Return a governed match or capture position.

operations.name: split
operations.semantic_contract: Split input around regex matches.

operations.name: replace-first
operations.semantic_contract: Replace the first applicable match.

operations.name: replace-all
operations.semantic_contract: Replace all matches under the host advancement rule.

operations.name: replace-callback
operations.semantic_contract: Compute replacement text from a match callback.

operations.name: expand-replacement
operations.semantic_contract: Expand a replacement template against existing match data.

operations.name: analyze
operations.semantic_contract: Return structured matching and non-matching regions.

operations.name: partial-match
operations.semantic_contract: Report whether more subject data could complete a match.

operations.name: stream-scan
operations.semantic_contract: Match across incrementally supplied subject blocks.

operations.name: block-scan
operations.semantic_contract: Match one contiguous block through a multi-pattern database.

operations.name: vector-scan
operations.semantic_contract: Match a logical subject supplied as several blocks.

operations.name: set-match
operations.semantic_contract: Report which members of a compiled pattern set match.
